kehillah_business_worker_trigger = {
	is_alive = yes
	is_adult = yes
	is_imprisoned = no
	is_incapable = no
	kehillah_is_baal_bayit_trigger = yes
	kehillah_householder_trigger = yes
	house ?= {
		NOT = { has_variable = kehillah_household_ruling }
		var:kehillah_household_head ?= prev
		exists = var:kehillah_household_of.holder
	}
}

kehillah_business_market_appointment_available_trigger = {
	kehillah_business_market_built_trigger = yes
	NOT = { employs_court_position = kehillah_business_market_position }
	any_courtier = { can_be_employed_as = kehillah_business_market_position }
}
kehillah_business_market_built_trigger = { OR = { domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = kehillah_market_stalls_01 } domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = kehillah_market_stalls_02 } domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = kehillah_market_stalls_03 } domicile ?= { has_domicile_building_or_higher = kehillah_town_sales_01 } } }
kehillah_business_market_staffed_trigger = {
	kehillah_business_market_built_trigger = yes
	any_court_position_holder = {
		type = kehillah_business_market_position

		house.var:kehillah_household_of = prev.primary_title
	}
}
